<timestamp>Monday, Sep 21, 2026, 9:49 PM (UTC+8)</timestamp>
<user_query>
整理今天的日报
</user_query>
先按日报规范对齐口径，再汇总今天实际做过的活。
继续汇总今日 work-log、派单与对话流水。

input.command: bash ~/.dc-platform/memory/scripts/prepare_daily_report_sync.sh 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "---HOST---"; echo "WORKLOG_HOST_ID=${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-unset}"; hostname; cat ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/.host_id 2>/dev/null; ls -la ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/reports/ 2>/dev/null | tail -5; ls -la ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/2026-09-21* 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/work-log/2026-09-21* 2>/dev/null
input.description: Sync dual-mac worklog and find today files

input.command: DATE=2026-09-21; echo "=== provenance ==="; rg -n "$DATE|2026-09-21" "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | tail -80; echo "=== inbox (today-ish) ==="; rg -n "2026-09-21|\"ts\".*21" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | tail -60; echo "=== sent today ==="; rg -n "2026-09-21" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.json" 2>/dev/null | tail -40; ls "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/" 2>/dev/null | head -30
